QuestInfo.name: Dowsing Time
QuestInfo.0: You found the Mirror World Map. Travel Mirror World to find the Goddess Teardrops.
QuestInfo.1: Dowsing is an old technique for finding underground water or minerals. #p2400008# claims to be able to locate strands of time with this technique. Doing so, he might be able to find the Goddess Teardrops.
QuestInfo.2: The Dowsing led you to a Time Relic! You need it to control your power of time.

0.0: This puzzle DOES appear to be a map, though. Can you see it? Ariant, Ludibrium... These are all areas of Maple World. They're a little out of place, but close enough.
0.1: I think this item may be the map of Mirror World. I'm thrilled that your first mission together went so well. Can't get any better than this!
0.2: See if you can find one of the Goddess Teardrops on this map. If you're worried about getting lost, speak with #b#p2400008##k. He's been studying.
